figurative_meaning_en: Superficial display; pretended wisdom or mannerism for show
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার সব কথাই উপরচালা, আসলে কিছুই জানে না।
সভায় সে উপরচালা করে বুদ্ধিমানের ভান করে।
example_sentences_in_english: All his words are just superficial show; he doesn't know anything really.
In the meeting, he puts on airs pretending to be wise.
note: Refers to feigned sophistication common in Bengali social critiques
